description.zh: 工单ID。可调用[ListOrders](~~465867~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ticket ID. You can call the [ListOrders](~~465867~~) operation to query the ticket ID.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

title.zh: 获取申请操作权限的工单详情
title.en: Obtain the details of a ticket for requesting operation permission

descriptions.zh: 本接口适用获取：**库-权限**、**表-权限**、**敏感列-权限**。
descriptions.en: This API is applicable for obtaining permissions for: **database-permission**, **table-permission**, and **sensitive column-permission**.
